→ Languages & frameworks

→ Microservices & architecture

→ Cloud & infrastructure
AWS, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, EVCache & Open Connect support global availability and high-performance delivery.

→ Data stores
Cassandra, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis & DynamoDB handle different storage and access patterns.

→ Big data & analytics
Kafka, Spark, Flink, Hadoop & Presto support event processing, analytics & large-scale data workloads.

Spinnaker, Jenkins, Titus, Datadog, New Relic, Atlas & Spectator help teams deploy, monitor & operate services continuously.
